title: Fix 6-digit pairing flow and add parent/child linking via phone number + SMS verification

requirements.text: Fix the pairing-code flow end-to-end so the backend generates a numeric code that is exactly 6 digits (as Text) and pairing only accepts exactly 6 digits, ensuring the current UI’s 6-digit constraints actually work with the backend.

quotes: o fluxo não está correto! ainda não me parece ter sido modificado para que seja a quantidade de dídigos tenha sido ajustada.

acceptanceCriteria: Calling the existing backend method used by the parent UI (generatePairingCode) returns a string matching /^\d{6}$/ (e.g., "042381").
Calling the existing backend method used by the child UI (pairWithParent) rejects any value that is not exactly 6 digits (non-numeric, shorter, longer) with a non-success result (e.g., invalidCode).
A newly generated 6-digit code can be used successfully by a child to create the parent↔child link, and the child then shows paired state (via getMyParent) without manual refresh.

requirements.text: Add a new pairing option for children to link to a parent/guardian by entering the parent’s phone number in the format (00)000000000, which triggers an SMS verification flow and then connects the logins (creates the same parent↔child relationship as the existing pairing-code flow).

quotes: crie uma nova opção para vincular as informações do filho com o PAI/MÃE por numero de celular, exemplo: ao filho inserir o numero de celular da PAI/MÃE (00)000000000 deve se enviar um SMS para o celular PAI/MÃE; faça com que após o filho inserir o SMS corretamente, os loguins sejam conectados

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend: The child pairing area offers two choices: (1) pair via 6-digit code (existing), (2) pair via parent phone number (new).

Frontend: The phone input enforces digits-only normalization and validates the exact mask length implied by (00)000000000 before submission; user-facing validation messages exist in i18n (en + pt-BR).

Backend: Parents can register/save a phone number associated with their account, and phone numbers are unique across accounts (attempting to claim an existing phone number fails with a clear, handled error).

Backend: When a child submits a parent phone number, the canister creates a time-limited verification challenge tied to (child principal, parent principal resolved by phone) and generates a 6-digit numeric OTP.

Backend: The system attempts to send the OTP via an SMS-sending mechanism; if a real SMS provider is not configured, the system must still allow the flow to be tested via a safe fallback (e.g., returning a status indicating “SMS not configured” while still storing the OTP for verification in development/test tooling).

Frontend: After the child enters the OTP correctly, the backend links the child to that parent (same internal link structure used by the current pairing flow), and the child UI updates to the paired state (getMyParent reflects the parent).
Backend: Incorrect OTP, expired OTP, too many attempts, unknown/unregistered parent phone, or child already paired are all handled with explicit result codes and corresponding UI error messages.

requirements.text: Extend the user profile setup/editing experience so a parent/guardian can provide (and later update) their phone number for phone-based pairing, without breaking existing profiles.

quotes: ...vincular ... por numero de celular... enviar um SMS ... para o celular PAI/MÃE...

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend: Parents see a phone number field during profile setup or in an obvious profile/account area, with validation matching the required phone format; children do not need to provide a phone number for this feature to work.
Backend: A parent’s phone number is stored and retrievable for pairing resolution; updates replace the prior value and maintain uniqueness constraints.
Existing users without a phone number can continue using the app and the existing 6-digit pairing-code flow unchanged.

requirements.text: Add/adjust frontend i18n strings (English and pt-BR) for the new phone-based pairing flow and for any new/updated validation and error states introduced by the fixed 6-digit pairing backend behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: All new user-visible labels, button text, help text, and error messages for phone-based pairing and OTP verification are sourced from i18n keys (en.ts and pt-BR.ts).
No hard-coded Portuguese user-facing strings are introduced in React components.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).

Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and anything under frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if an upgrade-safe state migration is strictly necessary.

If real SMS delivery requires an external provider, implement it in a provider-agnostic way (configurable) and also provide a safe fallback suitable for development/testing when provider credentials are not available.
nonGoals: Implementing a Twilio-specific integration or any SMS vendor-specific UI/branding.
Adding third-party authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Adding real-time messaging or push notifications.
